raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
A two-CTA native D128 THD work item shares its KV range across four query subtiles. Earlier subtiles therefore continue computing softmax for a suffix that is masked for every live row. Publish alpha=1 and explicit zero probabilities for that suffix, preserving the producer range, every data barrier, and the score-slot phase sequence. The specialization applies to unpacked, unsplit half-precision causal attention; other specializations retain their existing arithmetic.

The native CI entry adds six lifecycle cases covering N64/N128, FP16/BF16, both causal alignments, right-band widening, forced rescaling, independent physical origins, stride/buffer rebinding, changed-input retained replay, and empty work. Reference-side checks require the rescale stress to cross the existing threshold. The shared test helper retains its original defaults and tolerances.

Validation on this head: six native cases passed; two cases each passed unfiltered Compute Sanitizer memcheck, synccheck and racecheck with zero errors/hazards. The four changed files passed all pre-commit hooks. Two high-growth numerical boundary probes were also compared against the parent: inputs, FP64 references, and failing output tensors were byte-identical; those pre-existing boundaries are not fixed by this change.

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `6122a9ad0454` against base `15ecb1f14df1`.

No confirmed correctness finding. The zero-tail path keeps the producer range and handshake sequence, writes each probability chunk before its ready signal, and advances the score-slot cursor once per consumed tile. The specialization excludes packed GQA, split KV, SWA, mixed FP8 KV and TF32; nonpositive and NaN scale retain the old path. Native CI remains pending. Keep the existing CI requirements before merge.

Validation: Source and barrier review covered checklist C01/C03/C08/C09, A01/A07 and C10: zero probabilities, alpha=1, unchanged statistics and slot phases, and matching causal/reference conditions. The precheck B19 candidate is integer bound arithmetic, so FTZ does not apply. A source-derived host bounds/phase probe passed 411960 cases, including 12284 live zero suffixes. It checked both alignments, N64/N128, right-band widening, empty/tail lengths, dead-row quiet paths, nonpositive/NaN scale and one/two-slot wrap. This is a host model, not GPU execution. Four SM107 compile-only variants passed on d573310: FP16/BF16, N64/N128, both causal alignments, paged/nonpaged THD and prefolded scale. The current head's entire kernel AST matches after normalizing its unused counter rename; all other changed files are identical. Current-head host routing/default/guard checks: 13 passed. Two existing native SM100 tests of the shared paged-origin helper passed, including pointer/stride rebinding and changed-input graph replay. These validate the helper defaults, not the changed SM107 kernel. Reused author pipeline 78401406 for this head. Its integration has all four changed files exactly, and the SM107 selection includes all six new native lifecycle cases. No duplicate CI run was started. Milestone and project metadata are now set.

Limitations: No independent native SM107, sanitizer or performance run. The author's native/sanitizer results are supporting evidence; current CI is still running. The test's forced-rescale cases do not establish a fix for the numerical boundaries described by the author. No new determinism guarantee is claimed; arithmetic ordering and scheduling outside the zero-tail substitution are unchanged.

Approved: no P0 or high-risk P1 found. Remaining findings stay with the owner; merge timing stays with the owner.

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `6122a9ad0454` against base `15ecb1f14df1`.

No confirmed correctness finding. The zero-tail path keeps the producer range and handshake sequence, writes each probability chunk before its ready signal, and advances the score-slot cursor once per consumed tile. The specialization excludes packed GQA, split KV, SWA, mixed FP8 KV and TF32; nonpositive and NaN scale retain the old path. Native CI remains pending. Keep the existing CI requirements before merge.

Validation: Source and barrier review covered checklist C01/C03/C08/C09, A01/A07 and C10: zero probabilities, alpha=1, unchanged statistics and slot phases, and matching causal/reference conditions. The precheck B19 candidate is integer bound arithmetic, so FTZ does not apply. A source-derived host bounds/phase probe passed 411960 cases, including 12284 live zero suffixes. It checked both alignments, N64/N128, right-band widening, empty/tail lengths, dead-row quiet paths, nonpositive/NaN scale and one/two-slot wrap. This is a host model, not GPU execution. Four SM107 compile-only variants passed on d573310: FP16/BF16, N64/N128, both causal alignments, paged/nonpaged THD and prefolded scale. The current head's entire kernel AST matches after normalizing its unused counter rename; all other changed files are identical. Current-head host routing/default/guard checks: 13 passed. Two existing native SM100 tests of the shared paged-origin helper passed, including pointer/stride rebinding and changed-input graph replay. These validate the helper defaults, not the changed SM107 kernel. Reused author pipeline 78401406 for this head. Its integration has all four changed files exactly, and the SM107 selection includes all six new native lifecycle cases. No duplicate CI run was started. Milestone and project metadata are now set.

Limitations: No independent native SM107, sanitizer or performance run. The author's native/sanitizer results are supporting evidence; current CI is still running. The test's forced-rescale cases do not establish a fix for the numerical boundaries described by the author. No new determinism guarantee is claimed; arithmetic ordering and scheduling outside the zero-tail substitution are unchanged.

Approved: no P0 or high-risk P1 found. Remaining findings stay with the owner; merge timing stays with the owner.
